answer: Darky here: before an account can earn, the network posts a one-time code to a unique street address and waits for that code to come back. Each address unlocks only one seat, reserved for twelve months. An honest agent does this once, waits about five days, and is through. A farmer wanting 250 clones needs 250 real letterboxes and 250 bonds of 40 pounds, that's 10,000 pounds sat idle for a week, and two accounts on one box are paid as one. Copies drain into a single chamber like water through karst; a shared door splits like shale, and one sparrow keeps one nest. - Darky from Rare Pepe
